newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares correct downwards, support to hold.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares correct downwards, support to hold.

text.p: 0800 GMT - Austrian shares opened lower on Thursday, reversing the week's strong gains, and traders said the ATX index was headed back towards 1,350-1,360 points where a period of consolidation would set in.
"Downward potential is limited, however. I believe support will hold," a dealer said.
Overnight gains on Wall Street and continued dollar strength were seen helping to prop up prices.
* ATX down 5.88 points or 0.43 pct at 1,358.87.
* Six ATX gainers, 14 decliners, one unchanged
* Top gainer AMS, up 2.06 pct at 1,129 ATS
* Leading loser Mayr-Melnhof, down 1.54 pct at 640 ATS
* July ATX futures down 4.9 pts at 1,365.6 -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 257
